note: Independent rejudgment 2026-11-15 after the RTR response-identity and sequence changes. RFC 6810 Section 5.1 defines Protocol Version as 'currently 0' and says of Max Length: 'This MUST NOT be less than the Prefix Length element.' The current handlePDU still refuses an initial version-0 Prefix PDU before parseIPv4Prefix or parseIPv6Prefix; its Error Report code-4 branch refuses an advertised version below rtrVersionMin=1, and syncOnce retries only the supported version range 1 through 2. No version-0 Prefix exchange reaches the shared length validator. The new response-identity check can classify a version change within an established response as error 8 instead of initial unsupported-version error 4; it does not enable version 0. This row has no tagged tests and remains an owed version-0 implementation gap. Shared version-1/2 parser behavior gives this row no enforcement credit.
